content:
Hi all, we'd like to share two recent updates on MerLean, our agentic framework for autoformalization.

1. MerLean-prover on FormalQualBench
We extended MerLean into MerLean-prover, a system built to prove Lean theorems. We tested it on FormalQualBench, a benchmark of 23 graduate-level theorems in Lean 4. So far, MerLean-prover solves 8 out of 8 tested problems (all 82 statements, 100% success rate, no axioms, no sorry). Each problem was attempted once (N=1) with no human in the loop. All proofs are Comparator-verified. The remaining 15 problems will be tested next.
Results and Lean source: https://github.com/doxtor6/MerLean_FormalQualBench
Blog post: https://doxtor6.github.io/MerLean-examples/blog-post.html?post=blog2.md

2. Formalizing Balanced Product Quantum Codes
We used MerLean to formalize Balanced Product Quantum Codes by Breuckmann & Eberhardt — a foundational paper in Quantum Error Correction covering chain complexes, cohomology, CSS & LDPC codes, expander graphs, and the LPS construction. During formalization, MerLean's compile-fix loop and faithfulness checker caught a small discrepancy in Theorem 12, which the authors kindly confirmed. The full formalization is available as an interactive blueprint and dependency graph.
Blog post: https://doxtor6.github.io/MerLean-examples/blog-post.html?post=blog1.md

We'd love to hear any thoughts, questions, or feedback!
